title: Performance: message latency, streaming throughput, WG overhead
description: Write performance benchmarks: message round-trip latency (local vs remote), SSE streaming throughput (tokens/sec), WG tunnel overhead comparison. Establish baselines and verify no regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Message latency benchmark: local and remote baselines established
WG overhead: local vs remote latency delta measured
Benchmarks run with go test -bench and produce stable results
